_comment: Structural golden of the provider-facing JSON Schema. The labels (the root title and the $defs keys) are replaced by placeholders, because the rename was allowed to change the labels and nothing else. Any change to the structure below is a change to the contract the provider is held to.

<LABEL_1>.description:
The translated Vietnamese description text and its metadata.

The verification status is **always** ``unverified``. A translation
that completed is not a fact that was checked: the contract enforces
this, so a payload that claims ``verified`` is rejected outright
rather than being quietly downgraded.

text.description: The Vietnamese translation of the English source.
text.title: Text

within_target_range.description: True when the token count sits inside the soft target range. Server-owned, and purely informational.
within_target_range.title: Within Target Range

word_count.description: The number of whitespace-separated tokens in the text. Server-owned: the model may not author it, and the service recomputes it from the text it ships.
word_count.title: Word Count

<LABEL_1>.title: <LABEL_1>

<LABEL_2>.description:
Verification state of a single field.

``status`` defaults to ``"unknown"`` so a field that omits the
object entirely is treated as *nothing known* rather than *verified*.

checked_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the last verification attempt, with an explicit UTC indicator (e.g. '2026-10-27T08:15:00+00:00'). Set only by the service, and only when a deterministic check actually ran: the presence of a timestamp is not proof that the check succeeded.
checked_at.title: Checked At

note.description: Free-form note about the verification state. Never a fact.
note.title: Note

status.description: 'verified' (checked against evidence), 'unverified' (a value exists but was never checked), 'conflicting' (sources disagree, no winner selected) or 'unknown' (nothing known).
status.title: Status

<LABEL_2>.title: <LABEL_2>

structure.description:
The payload the model is asked to produce.

It contains the translated text and nothing else. Every other
field of the response - the deterministic Steam facts, the
description-source block, the warnings - is owned by the service.
structure.title: <LABEL_0>
